description: Source code for IndexShuffleBlockResolver class in Apache Spark, responsible for managing shuffle block files, including creation, retrieval, validation, and metadata handling within Spark's shuffle mechanism.

classes.name: IndexShuffleBlockResolver
classes.description: Manages shuffle block files, including creation, retrieval, validation, and metadata handling for Spark shuffle operations.

methods.name: getDataFile
methods.description: Retrieves the data file for a given shuffle and map ID, optionally specifying directories.

methods.name: getIndexFile
methods.description: Retrieves the index file for a given shuffle and map ID, optionally specifying directories.

methods.name: removeDataByMap
methods.description: Deletes data, index, and checksum files associated with a specific map ID in a shuffle.

methods.name: checkIndexAndDataFile
methods.description: Validates that index and data files match and returns partition lengths if valid.

methods.name: putShuffleBlockAsStream
methods.description: Streams a shuffle block to disk, used for block migration.

methods.name: getMigrationBlocks
methods.description: Retrieves index and data blocks for migration purposes.

methods.name: writeMetadataFileAndCommit
methods.description: Atomically writes data, index, and checksum metadata files for a shuffle map output.

methods.name: writeMetadataFile
methods.description: Writes index or checksum metadata to a temporary file and atomically renames it.

methods.name: getMergedBlockData
methods.description: Reads all chunks in a merged shuffle file for local consumption.

methods.name: getMergedBlockMeta
methods.description: Reads metadata for a merged shuffle block.

methods.name: getChecksums
methods.description: Reads checksum values from a checksum file.

methods.name: getChecksumFile
methods.description: Retrieves the checksum file for a shuffle block, optionally specifying directories.

methods.name: getBlockData
methods.description: Retrieves a range of data for a shuffle block, given its ID.

methods.name: getBlocksForShuffle
methods.description: Returns the index and data block IDs for a given shuffle and map ID.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the resolver, performing any necessary cleanup.
